scope: All stocks in both pinned verified Toss long-history collections, preserving exact-identity approved exclusions. No cap/liquidity filter. All available historical bars processed, not only the previous selected arrays. During input inventory, before outcome ranking, add33 unique prior KR histories and3 selected-chart ADR histories; duplicate stock histories are not counted twice. Current-listing universe with limited historical KR additions, not comprehensive historical delisted universe. No new market/account calls.
source_cutoff: 2026-09-30, archive common cutoff. Prior study ended2026-10-15 with other providers; source and sample both differ, so changes are not attributed solely to expanded universe.

periods.all: All stored historical dates with valid context, descriptive
periods.test: 2023-04-01 through2025-09-30; L1 fit through2026-09-30. These historical dates were previously studied; temporal comparison, not untouched prospective validation.

label: Identical prior objective 0.5||log(close)-x||²+1.0||D2 x||1. Dual gap<1e-8. DOWN edge iff x[t+1]-x[t]<-1e-6. New run starts at first DOWN edge with finite preceding non-DOWN edge. No merging. Duration10..20/21..62/63+ mutually exclusive; shorter runs retained outside target. Unknown-edge terminal runs censored.
quality: Verify source and wrapped hashes/identity using SavedHistory. Invalid bars, zero-volume bars, explicit missing sessions and >10 calendar-day gaps break segments. Do not fill. Require65 prior and126 subsequent same-segment observations and finite future fitted values. Prices are stored provider-adjusted values; unverified corporate actions remain a limitation. No invented split-adjustment of volume.
features: 63 causal fixed events in features.py, indicators independent of L1 labels. Parameters frozen in code. Warmup and missing values remain -1; missing is not false. Candlestick/day-specific events can occur consecutively. State thresholds generally use first entry. SMA5/SMA10/SMA5 with rising20 retained as controls, excluded from selection.
baseline: Same stock/year non-start trading dates, identical window length and valid input requirement. Event-count weighted matched baseline, not comparison to single-day frequency. Start windows are retrospective enrichment.
precision: All actual event days, including false positives, are denominator. Match starts within±5; report lead and same/post separately, duration-specific and any>=10-day event. 1-precision means not near a target L1 onset, not necessarily a harmless correction. Also joint fitted decline>=5%.
context: Standardize no-signal near-onset rates to signal distribution within same stock/calendar-quarter and observable current MA20 five-day slope, close vs MA20 and RSI>=60 (8 strata). No use of retrospective L1 state in features or matching. Missing comparator strata are omitted with support reported. Sensitivity association, not causal/predictive proof.
selection: Before inspecting test ranks, TRAIN top2 per market/duration/window (lead,post), ranked by event-window rate minus matched baseline. Need>=200 onsets,>=50 hits,>=10% capture,>=1.5 lift, baseline<=25%, <=12 signals/252 valid bars, >=30 stocks with signals; controls excluded. No parameter or combination search. All63 results exported. No eligible candidate means none; criteria not relaxed.
uncertainty: Frozen candidate TEST event enrichment: crossed symbol and calendar-quarter Poisson bootstrap2000 reps, seeded7021; marginal95% percentile plus Bonferroni simultaneous normal intervals using bootstrap SE. Conservatively allocate to3 times candidate count for enrichment, context-adjusted near-onset effect, and strict future1..5 onset effect for lead candidates. Signal precision/context adjustment separately reported. Correlated signals and market regimes are not independent experiments.
robustness: KR and US separately; years, equal-symbol signal precision, all-history descriptive comparison, nearby-signal median offset and onset-close to first same/post next-open decline. No hindsight peak execution. No claim of sales profitability; no orders, alerts, plan adoption or operational changes.
